recent_articles.title: TDP leverages technology in organising hybrid Mahanadu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Telugu Desam Party (TDP)** held its virtual Mahanadu 2026, a hybrid event with over seven lakh cadres participating. Chandrababu Naidu** delivered his presidential message to participants across the state, utilizing a GPS-enabled digital invitation system and a central command-and-control center.  The event aimed to be cost-efficient and inclusive by leveraging technology.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool MLA arrested, several leaders quit party post - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dilip Mondal**, a Trinamool Congress MLA from Bishnupur, was arrested by **West Bengal police** in Odisha on Wednesday (May 27, 2026) after days of evading arrest. The arrest follows an investigation into alleged threats against **BJP** workers during the West Bengal Assembly elections and a previous complaint filed against him.  The arrest marks the first time a sitting MLA has been apprehended by **West Bengal police**. This comes amidst a wave of arrests targeting local Trinamool Congress workers, including former Minister **Sujit Bose**, for their alleged involvement in corruption and post-poll violence. The situation is further complicated by mass resignations from Trinamool leaders, including senior leader **Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar** and several councillors.  The party's leadership is also facing criticism for the lack of a designated space for the Leader of Opposition, **Sovandeb Chattopadhyay**, in the West Bengal Assembly premises.

recent_articles.title: Raichur MP raises concern over proposed Information Technology Act amendments - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **G. Kumar Naik**, a member of the **Parliamentary Standing Committee on Communication and Information Technology**, has urged **Ashwini Vaishnaw**, Union Minister for Electronics and Information Technology, to reconsider certain provisions in the draft Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Second Amendment Rules 2026.  **Naik** expressed concerns that the proposed amendments could impact democratic participation, free expression, and Constitutional safeguards by expanding the scope of Part III of the rules and enabling direct Ministry referrals to an Inter-Departmental Committee without a complaint from an aggrieved party. He also raised objections to linking intermediary safe harbor protections under Section 79 of the Information Technology Act 2000 to compliance with government advisories, clarifications, and standard operating procedures.  **Naik** emphasized the importance of balancing platform accountability and online safety with Constitutional guarantees of free expression and independent oversight in India's evolving digital governance framework.

recent_articles.title: Glitches in CBSE portal leave Class 12 students seeking re-evaluation hassled - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following complaints from students and parents about the new On-Screen Marking (OSM) system, **Union Minister for Education Dharmendra Pradhan** requested a detailed report from the **Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)**. The OSM system, which replaced traditional paper evaluation, faced technical glitches leading to issues with re-evaluation, portal crashes, and blurred answer sheet scans.  Congress general secretary (communications) Jairam Ramesh criticized the government's handling of the situation, calling for the resignation of **Dharmendra Pradhan**.  The CBSE has extended the deadline for re-evaluation applications and is working to address technical issues with the system.

recent_articles.title: Inclusion of Maithili in CBSE curriculum will connect future generation to their roots: Bihar CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary** hailed the decision by the **Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)** to include Maithili as a subject at the secondary level starting in 2026-27. Mr. Saraogi emphasized that the inclusion will promote language learning and cultural understanding among future generations.

recent_articles.title: CBSE again extends deadline for scanned answer book requests till May 25 - The Hindu

The extension follows complaints from students about difficulties accessing the portal.  **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** sought support from the **Union Finance Ministry** to overhaul the CBSE payment gateway system and has directed IIT-Madras and IIT-Kanpur teams to assist in resolving technical issues.

recent_articles.title: Minister’s assurance on Plus One seats brings relief to north Kerala students - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Janivara and hijab row: KEA to turn down demand by 3 students for re-exam in all subjects - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Three students who were forced to remove their janivara during the Physics Common Entrance Test (CET-2026) in Bengaluru have rejected **KEA’s** offer for a re-examination of just the Physics paper. recent_articles.title: Kerala seeks urgent intervention over CBSE Plus Two evaluation complaints - The Hindu

Samsudheen has requested the **Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)** and the **Union government** to intervene in the controversy surrounding the evaluation of CBSE Class XII examination papers under the On-Screen Marking (OSM) system. recent_articles.title: West Bengal gained infamy due to recruitment scams, new recruitment policy in next Budget session: CM - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: A.P. continues to grapple with intense heat as 95 mandals record above 42°C - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh** continues to experience intense heat, with 95 out of 688 mandals recording temperatures above 42°C.  The highest temperature reached 45.8°C at Kanumolu in Krishna district. While some districts received light to moderate rainfall on Saturday, severe heatwave conditions are expected for 21 mandals and widespread heatwave conditions for 214 mandals on Sunday. The **India Meteorological Department (IMD)** predicts that weather systems brewing over the Bay of Bengal may bring isolated showers with lightning and thunderstorms in coastal Andhra Pradesh and Rayalaseema next week, but this activity is not expected to be widespread.

recent_articles.title: CPI(M) demands scrapping NTA, seeks Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: I don’t think the ruling party has the stomach for sarcasm, says Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: India successfully test-fires Agni-1 ballistic missile from Odisha - The Hindu

Experts suggest that India needs to accelerate battery storage development to manage surplus solar energy during nighttime hours.

recent_articles.title: Lakshmi could have been a child bride - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: NSUI holds protest outside Education Minister’s residence over NEET paper leak - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Tata Power shares crash 7% after Q4. What are Goldman Sachs and Motilal Oswal saying? - The Economic Times

Brokerage firms like Goldman Sachs and Motilal Oswal Financial Services maintain "Sell" and "Buy" ratings respectively on **Tata Power**, highlighting the company's strong long-term growth potential in rooftop solar and distribution, while acknowledging challenges with renewable energy generation execution.

recent_articles.title: ECI set to roll out phase III of SIR in ‘coming days’ to cover 22 States, UTs - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Education Budget will grow every year, says Telangana CM Revanth Reddy - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: CITU calls South Coast Railway zone a “betrayal” of Andhra Pradesh, flags revenue loss - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: NHA recognises innovators for developing AI systems for healthcare claims processing and fraud detection - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: West Bengal Cabinet 2026: From Dilip Ghosh to Agnimitra Paul, Ministers who were sworn in along with Suvendu Adhikari - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Census enumerators ID can be verified through QR code - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Telangana leads India in human trafficking cases, women form vast majority of victims - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Gurugram gated societies not letting in enumerators; FIRs recommended against enumerators obstructing Census work - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: In a first, world’s smallest wild cat snapped with kitten in Faridabad; confirms breeding outside protected areas, say researchers - The Hindu

The research paper documenting this discovery was published in Zoo’s Print.

recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Biju Janata Dal (BJD)** announced the appointment of **Manas Ranjan Mangaraj** as its new leader in the Rajya Sabha.  **Mangaraj**, a first-time Rajya Sabha MP, will lead the party's parliamentary group following the resignation of **Sasmit Patra**.  The BJD also appointed **Sulata Deo** as deputy leader and chief whip. The party currently has six members in the Rajya Sabha but does not have any representation in the Lok Sabha after losing all its seats to the Bharatiya Janata Party in 2024 general elections.

recent_articles.title: Consolidated voters’ list of 9 States and 3 UTs that underwent SIR Phase II trimmed by 10.2% - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Election Commission of India** announced the results of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in nine states and three Union Territories. **Uttar Pradesh** recorded the highest net deletion of voters at 2.04 crore, followed by **West Bengal**, with a net deletion of 83.86 lakh. The SIR phase II identified 67 lakh deceased voters and 1.28 crore duplicate voters across these states and UTs.  The consolidated electoral rolls saw a reduction of 10.2%, bringing the number of active voters down to 45.81 crore.
